value.text: {"sql": "SELECT local_day, MAX(usgs_northport_stage_ft) - MIN(usgs_northport_stage_ft) AS stage_change_ft FROM (SELECT to_date(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS local_day, usgs_northport_stage_ft FROM water.hourly_compare WHERE hr_utc >= '2026-10-19 05:00' AND hr_utc < '2026-10-25 05:00' AND usgs_northport_stage_ft IS NOT NULL) t GROUP BY local_day ORDER BY local_day", "purpose": "Estimate daily pool storage change from Northport stage change"},
